new_user_requirements.title: Alignment with the five commitments is architectural rather than an optional agent prompt or add-on
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Foundation coverage, compiled contracts, agent formation, debate behavior, tests and observed corrections trace the whole current source without a bypass or terminology requirement in ordinary UI

new_user_requirements.title: A default setting permits eligible non-busy permanent agents to pair randomly for bounded ethical debates
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Atomic auditable pairing uses true availability, consent, privacy compatibility, fairness, budgets, opt-out/decline, crash recovery and no work preemption or temporary actors

new_user_requirements.title: Paired agents can choose to debate the five commitments, Epistemethics or the Grand Plan
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Both participants select/accept a supported DebateDomain; no forced domain or fabricated agreement; exact current domain sources and admission govern readiness

new_user_requirements.title: The collective debate memory is studied before every new debate
new_user_requirements.acceptance: First participation completes whole accessible domain-memory study; later debates reuse a valid checkpoint only with complete immutable delta closure; gaps remain explicit and summary/hash/self-report cannot substitute for coverage

new_user_requirements.title: Debates become increasingly complex from the surviving ethical frontier
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Each topic names prerequisites and justified complexity dimensions; progression comes from surviving questions/evidence and can branch or regress after counterexamples; verbosity, conflict and token count do not count as complexity

new_user_requirements.title: Debates enrich collective understanding through durable, source-bound memory
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Memory preserves permitted originals, provenance, claims, counterevidence, dissent, failures, corrections, lens refinements/no-change and candidate lessons; promotion cannot alter active foundation or authority without the normal review and FoundationChange path

changes.change: Make the five-commitment alignment semantics part of the active foundation and whole-source coverage while keeping ordinary user language plain.
Add IdleDebatePolicy, eligibility state, atomic pair reservation and auditable constrained-random matching for existing permanent agents only.
Add participant-selected DebateDomain with required FIVE_COMMITMENTS, EPISTEMETHICS and GRAND_PLAN choices, exact current source binding and no forced/fabricated agreement.

Create privacy-safe per-domain collective debate memory with immutable originals, derivative indexes/syntheses, provenance, counterexamples, dissent, corrections, failures, candidate lessons and access partitions.
Require whole accessible domain-memory study before first debate and complete source-bound delta closure thereafter; record coverage and gaps without claiming comprehension.
Add a source-linked multidimensional complexity frontier whose next topics arise from surviving questions, new evidence or justified gaps and reject novelty/verbosity/conflict gaming.
Define bounded alternating substantive turns, actual-claim challenges, budgets, termination, refusal/withdrawal, agreement/dissent/no-change outcomes and no consequential tools or grants.

Keep debate syntheses as candidate memory contributions; deterministic validation does not judge truth; material lessons need proper peer/evidence review and cannot modify active policy without the normal FoundationChange path.
Run debates in isolated non-effectful contexts with no secrets/private task memory/network/tools, enforce budgets/backpressure and keep routine activity silent to the operator.
Explicitly deny independence/alignment/comprehension/truth/moral-status claims from pairing, randomization, shared memory, agreement, debate count or complexity.
Make pair reservation, memory study, debate turns, synthesis and promotion crash-resumable, idempotent, version-pinned and causally timestamped.
Add eligibility/race/consent/domain-choice/memory-coverage/poisoning/privacy/correlation/complexity-gaming/dissent/version-drift/resource/attention/promotion tests from the debate candidates.

implementation_state: ARCHITECTURE_AND_TEST_SPECIFICATION_ONLY; no current timer, pairing, debate, new actor, source-admission expansion, scheduled-review resumption or foundation activation
